title: Quick start guide
slide_intent: Introduce the scope in language that gives readers an immediate way to think about the system.
strategic_value: Calling the components ingredients can connect identity work to the food that anchors Instacart’s business.
demonstration: A single large statement on orange describes the book as a quick start guide to the brand ingredients and their use.
practical_value: Use this page to introduce a practical collection before giving a reader its inventory.
